GameSystem.intro: One text, a synchronized start, and every correct keystroke moves your exorcist down the track. Those at the back use their technique to strike the leaders.

CharactersPage.title: Exorcist registry
CharactersPage.intro: Eight playable exorcists. Open a file to read their technique and their race ability.

domainDetails.gojo: Endless information floods the mind of everyone caught inside: every other exorcist is stuck in place until the domain closes.
domainDetails.megumi: Every shikigami of the Ten Shadows answers at once: while the domain is open, all of them activate automatically, every second, except Mahoraga, who is never summoned.
domainDetails.yuta: Swords holding every technique Yuta has copied fill the domain. While it is open, he picks one up every second and casts its copied technique, automatically and for free.
domainDetails.sukuna: The shrine cuts into everyone’s text: every second, one more word is added to every other exorcist’s text until the domain closes.

todo.track: Miniature track: Todo, lagging behind, swaps places with the leader.
todo.before: Todo is lagging behind and {rival} leads the race: there is a long stretch of typing left to catch up.
todo.cast: He presses his technique key, then types its exact name. The word is valid: Todo claps his hands.
todo.after: Boogie-Woogie! Todo and {rival} swap places: Todo takes the lead without typing another word, and {rival} drops behind.

blackFlash.track: Miniature track: Yuji hits Todo with Black Flash, stunning him and boosting cursed energy.
blackFlash.before: Yuji is behind {rival}. A well-timed Black Flash can stop the leader in his tracks.
blackFlash.cast: Yuji types the technique name. His fist strikes with a burst of black and red cursed energy.
blackFlash.after: {rival} is stunned for 2 to 3 s while Yuji catches up. Black Flash also boosts Yuji’s passive cursed energy accumulation.

divergentFist.track: Miniature track: Yuji hits Todo twice with Divergent Fist, delaying the rival’s typing.
divergentFist.before: Yuji is behind {rival}. Divergent Fist can disrupt the leader’s typing rhythm.
divergentFist.cast: Yuji types the technique name. His fist lands first; a second impact of cursed energy follows a moment later.
divergentFist.after: For 2 to 3 s, {rival}’s characters appear late after each keypress. Yuji keeps running and closes the gap.

resonance.track: Miniature track: Nobara drives a nail into her straw doll and stuns Yuji with Resonance.
resonance.before: Nobara is behind {rival}. Resonance can freeze the leader where he stands.
resonance.cast: Nobara types the technique name and hammers a nail into her straw doll. The blow resonates straight into her target.
resonance.after: {rival} is stunned for 3 to 5 s and can’t type. Nobara keeps running and closes the gap.

hairpin.track: Miniature track: Nobara plants her nails with Hairpin, adding words to Yuji’s text.
hairpin.before: Nobara is behind {rival}. Hairpin can make the leader’s race longer.
hairpin.cast: Nobara types the technique name. Her nails burst and plant themselves in her target’s text.
hairpin.after: {rival}’s text gets extra words: his finish line moves away while Nobara closes the gap.

yuji.title: his fists
yuji.intro: Yuji has no spells, only his fists. Costs are in cursed energy (CE).

divergentFist.name: Divergent Fist
divergentFist.effect: The attacked player’s typing lags: characters show up late after each keypress for 2 to 3 s.

blackFlash.name: Black Flash
blackFlash.effect: Stuns the targeted player for 2 to 3 s and boosts Yuji’s passive CE accumulation rate.

megumi.title: shikigami
megumi.intro: Each shikigami has its own effect. Costs are in cursed energy (CE).

rabbitEscape.name: Rabbit Escape
rabbitEscape.effect: Megumi is untouchable for 3 s, domains included.

toad.name: Toad
toad.effect: Grabs a player: they lose one word.

roundDeer.name: Round Deer
roundDeer.effect: Sends the next attack back to its sender.

mahoraga.name: Mahoraga
mahoraga.effect: Megumi gives up his chance to win to summon it. Mahoraga races as a bot from where Megumi stood, and doubles its speed with every letter it types.

nobara.title: cursed nails
nobara.intro: Every strike on the straw doll lands on its target. Costs are in cursed energy (CE).

resonance.name: Resonance
resonance.effect: Stuns the targeted player for 3 to 5 s.

hairpin.name: Hairpin
hairpin.effect: Adds words to the targeted player’s text.

gojo.title: the six eyes
gojo.intro: Limitless bends infinity three ways: Blue, Red and Hollow Purple. Costs are in cursed energy (CE).

blue.name: Blue
blue.effect: Freezes the targeted player in place for 3 to 5 s.

red.name: Red
red.effect: Deflects the next incoming attack. Stays active until it is used.

sukuna.title: the king of curses
sukuna.intro: Cleave, Dismantle and Divine Flames: each strike destroys the words coming up. Costs are in cursed energy (CE).

dismantle.name: Dismantle
dismantle.effect: Crushes Sukuna’s next word to pieces.

divineFlames.name: Divine Flames
divineFlames.effect: Destroys Sukuna’s next three words. Only available right after Cleave then Dismantle; if the chain is broken, it can’t be cast.

yuta.title: his copied techniques
yuta.intro: Through Rika, Yuta borrows other sorcerers’ techniques. Costs are in cursed energy (CE).

jacobsLadder.name: Jacob’s Ladder
jacobsLadder.effect: Seals the targeted player’s techniques: they cannot use any for 3 to 5 s.

cursedSpeech.name: Cursed Speech
cursedSpeech.effect: “Don’t move.” The targeted player cannot type for 3 to 5 s.

skyManipulation.name: Sky Manipulation
skyManipulation.effect: Sends the next attack Yuta receives back to its sender.

descriptions.yuji: First-year student at the Tokyo school of sorcery. Vessel of Sukuna, he makes up for his lack of spells with tremendous physical strength.
descriptions.megumi: A calm, methodical sorcerer, heir to a technique of the Zenin clan.
descriptions.nobara: She left the countryside for Tokyo and moves forward without ever doubting herself.
descriptions.gojo: Teacher of the first years and the strongest sorcerer of his era. His blindfold hides the Six Eyes.
descriptions.maki: Rejected by her clan, she earned her place by the strength of her weapons.
descriptions.yuta: A second-year student haunted by Rika, the cursed spirit he once bound himself to.
descriptions.todo: A towering Kyoto student. He judges people by their type.
descriptions.sukuna: The King of Curses, sealed for a thousand years in twenty fingers. Yuji’s body now serves as his vessel.

techniqueDetails.yuji: Yuji has no innate technique, so he relies on what he has: tremendous physical strength and fists wrapped in cursed energy.
techniqueDetails.megumi: Megumi has access to shikigami. Each one of them has a different effect, affecting either Megumi or another sorcerer.
techniqueDetails.nobara: Nobara drives a cursed nail into a straw doll holding a piece of her target: whatever she strikes on the doll, the target feels, wherever they are.
techniqueDetails.gojo: Limitless brings infinity into the real world: everything that approaches Gojo slows down endlessly and never reaches him. He can also bend it to pull targets in or blast them away.
techniqueDetails.maki: Born with almost no cursed energy, she gets a superhuman body and senses in exchange.
techniqueDetails.yuta: With his shikigami Rika, Yuta can copy other jujutsu sorcerers’ techniques.
techniqueDetails.todo: When activated, it lets the user swap places with anything that has cursed energy.
techniqueDetails.sukuna: Cleave adjusts to its target’s toughness and cursed energy to cut it in a single stroke; Dismantle slices through everything around him. To finish, he unleashes Fuga: an arrow of fire that sets everything ablaze.

Guide.intro: A race is won on the keyboard, but cursed energy and techniques stop the leaders from running away with it.

type.title: Type right, move forward
type.text: Same text, same signal for everyone. Every correct character moves your exorcist forward; first to the line wins.
type.sample: curses are born from human emotions

charge.title: Charge your cursed energy
charge.text: Every correct character fills the bar, faster on a flawless streak. Energy pays for your techniques and your domain. Now and then, a correct key lands a Black Flash: it stuns someone up front and doubles your charge for a few seconds.
charge.label: Cursed energy

catchUp.title: Catch the leaders
catchUp.text: Every exorcist has their character's. From behind, it strikes the top half of the race, and hits harder the further behind you are.

domain.title: Domain Expansion
domain.text: Hits every other exorcist in the race, leaders and chasers alike. Not every character has one.

restriction.title: Heavenly Restriction
restriction.text: Maki Zenin has neither technique nor domain. In exchange, enemy domains have no effect on her.

host.title: The host decides
host.text: Before the race, the host picks the mode: Normal, Unlimited CE, No Domain, or Heavenly Restricted for a pure keyboard race.

finish.title: Everyone finishes
finish.text: No effect can stop you from crossing the line: they are all limited in time or length.

bots.title: Bots on equal terms
bots.text: Bots type, charge and cast their techniques with exactly the same rules as you.

vow.title: Binding Vow
vow.text: Forfeit your technique for the rest of the race and get {percent, number}% of the race’s progress at once.

controls.title: Controls
controls.intro: Hold {key} and press a key. For a domain or a technique, then type its exact name to cast it. Your first 3 keys are forgiven and only pick the ability: after that, one mistake and the cast fails, at no CE cost.
controls.warning: Make sure none of your macros or system shortcuts use {combos}: they would take over and the site would never receive the keys.

TopExorcists.title: Special grade
TopExorcists.empty: No one is ranked yet. Finish races to claim the first spot.

CookieConsent.title: Cookies
CookieConsent.body: Curse Typer uses essential cookies for your session, guest profile and sign-in. With your consent, it also remembers your language.
CookieConsent.note: Essential cookies always stay on: the game can't work without them. You can change your mind with the “Cookies” link at the bottom of the page.

settings.title: Race settings
settings.readOnly: Only the host can change these settings.

complexityHints.easy: Short words, 2 to 5 letters. Real text with short words on average.
complexityHints.medium: Words of 4 to 7 letters. Real text of ordinary length.
complexityHints.hard: Long words, 6 letters and more. Real text with long words on average.

settings.practiceHint: Shown more often in the text, e.g. , . / z
settings.excludeHint: Never written in the text, even in real passages (those that contain them are skipped, random words are used if none fits).

errorHints.accumulate: Mistakes stay in the text and cost points.
errorHints.block: You can't go on until you type the right character.

visibilityHints.public: Listed in the lobby list. Anyone can join.
visibilityHints.code: Hidden from the lobby list. Join with the code or an invite link.
visibilityHints.private: Hidden from the lobby list. Join only with an invite link.

gameModeHints.normal: Cursed energy, techniques, domains and Black Flash.
gameModeHints.unlimitedCe: Everyone starts full and nothing costs CE. Maki still has none.
gameModeHints.noDomain: Techniques stay on, but nobody can open a domain.
gameModeHints.heavenly: A pure keyboard race: no cursed energy and nothing that uses it.
